source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.3 (PDF 234) in the book's order, with a self-check.

blocks.text: Magnetic flux linkage electromagnetism ka aham concept (khayal) hai, khaas taur par inductance aur electromagnetic induction ki parhai mein. Flux linkage ka matlab hai coil ke ek loop se guzarne wala magnetic flux zarb (×) coil ke turns (chakkaron) ki number (ginti). Yeh batata hai ke coil ke bohat se turns ki wajah se kitna flux coil se 'jura' (linked) hai. Coils aur inductors circuits mein kaise kaam karte hain, yeh samajhne ke liye yeh zaroori hai.

blocks.text_alt: Magnetic flux linkage = Φ = N ϕ_B … (10.7)

blocks.text: Yahan ϕ_B area (jagah ka phailao) A wale ek loop se magnetic flux hai aur N coil ke kul turns hain. Flux linkage transformers, electric motors, generators aur inductors ke design aur kaam mein bara role ada karta hai. Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke law (qaida) mein bhi yeh bohat aham hai, jo hum isi chapter mein aage parhenge.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Jab aap credit ya ATM card Automated Teller Machine (ATM) mein dalte hain: card ki magnetic patti (strip) mein laakhon nanhe magnetic domains hote hain jo resin ke binder (jorne wali cheez) se jure hote hain. Machine is patti par likhi (encoded) information parhti hai aur aap ko aap ke account tak access (pohanch) deti hai.

blocks.caption: Flux aur flux linkage
rows: ek loop se field lines, BA cosθ
ek loop ka flux × turns ki number

blocks.prompt: 10 turns aur 35 cm² area wali coil 0.5 T ki field mein rakhi hai, field coil ki surface (oopar ki teh) ke perpendicular hai. Is ka flux linkage kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek turn se flux: ϕ_B = BA = 0.5 × 35 × 10⁻⁴ = 1.75 × 10⁻³ Wb. Flux linkage = Nϕ_B = 10 × 1.75 × 10⁻³ = 1.75 × 10⁻² Wb. Agar coil 1.0 s mein field se bahar nikal li jaye to yeh linkage zero ho jata hai aur average (darmiyani value) induced emf 1.75 × 10⁻² V hoti hai (numerical 10.6).

items: Flux linkage Φ = Nϕ_B (10.7): ek loop ka flux × turns ki number; transformers, motors, generators, inductors aur Faraday ke law ke liye basic (jar wali).
ATM card ki magnetic patti nanhe magnetic domains mein information rakhti hai.
